features.name: Validated local declaration and expression annotations
features.scope: Source-retained annotations on local values, local functions, and expressions retain target, duplicate, use-site, type and constant argument validation. Builtin kotlin.Suppress accepts UNCHECKED_CAST and RestrictedApi. Custom or shadowed annotations remain ordinary annotations.
restrictions: Other suppression keys reject explicitly because they may change diagnostic validity. Runtime-retained local annotations, context-dependent annotation constants and string-template subparser annotations remain explicit boundaries.
Pinned original cases 249, 256 and 385 advance to subsequent independently reported barriers. No application runtime claim.

corrections.reason: The development negative fixture incorrectly assumed an error-affecting suppression would make private access valid; the official compiler rejected it. The corrected fixture uses a valid body and unsupported key.
Context-dependent annotation constants now reject as an explicit unsupported boundary before constant evaluation. The fresh final report passes.
